correctness.rationale: The exact Poisson objective is positive. The endpoint-family log objective is strictly concave from positive increasing concave intensity integrals and strictly concave detection log. At its unique optimizer, the endogenous weighted intensity is strictly convex; derivative boundary equalities/inequalities prove the optimizer is its unique top-measure set over the entire night. The concave supporting-hyperplane inequality then proves global uniqueness for all measurable recording sets. Threshold functions are strictly decreasing with correct endpoint limits; the symmetry and uniform short-budget expansion are valid. The packaged independent numerical checks passed 11,846 assertions including exhaustive finite configurations, which are diagnostics, not a substitute for proof. Endpoints B=0/B=H and nonpositive rates are excluded.

evidence: Skalak et al. (2012), https://doi.org/10.1111/j.2041-210X.2011.00177.x, Discussion, studies nocturnal and seasonal empirical detectability and recommends extensive night coverage for rare bat species, without an analytic fixed-time two-species global design theorem.

Balantic and Donovan (2019), https://doi.org/10.1002/ece3.5579, introduces a more general application algorithm over sites/species/days, but optimizes fixed externally weighted hourly scores and reports simulation comparisons rather than a theorem for every measurable set and a joint product criterion.

originality.rationale: Compared the exact object, the product-of-two Poisson no-call complements objective, admissible arbitrary measurable sets, and endpoint-only/unique-split/three-regime consequences. Full material from four ecological primary works, including the closest 2019 adaptive recording algorithm, gave time-of-day sampling applications but no theorem implying these specific global shape and sharp boundary classifications. Published mathematical-record results have different state, data and objective structures; no matching or stronger implication was evidenced. A known supporting-hyperplane/strict-convexity method is explicitly acknowledged, and historical novelty is provisional pending wider expert review.
residual_risks: Known general concave integral-functional optimality and strictly convex superlevel-set principles might imply this particular theorem as a corollary under another name; the variational method is not claimed original.

No exhaustive search of nonindexed, non-English, or older control-theory monographs was possible. The novelty assessment is conditional on inspected full primary materials and actual published-record search results.

Real ecological calling statistics can be non-Poisson, nonstationary across nights, dependent across species, or imperfectly classified; these are relevance/model restrictions, not mathematical exceptions to the proved theorem.

value.rationale: The motivating species-inventory gap is choice of finite recording time when two targets have complementary diurnal calling rates. This complete classification reduces arbitrary measurable recording-set optimization to an exact unique scalar split; the end-window theorem rules out all interior-only and irregular schedules and proves finite critical call amplitudes where the whole budget moves to one end. The universal equal-split short-budget limit, despite arbitrary fixed rate imbalance, adds a structural scale transition. It is a motivated mathematical benchmark and not a field recommendation.
